# Matiks referral · concept case study

> Concept UX case study by Harshal: situation-based referral slide-ups inside Matiks play (close win, personal best, streak), 150 XP tracking, and a pass-it-on acquisition loop. Proposed feature — not a live Matiks ship.

This file helps AI agents find the readable versions of the case study.

## Primary pages

- [Case study (HTML)](https://matiks-concept-project.vercel.app/): Full visual case study with research, decisions, prototype, and edge cases.
- [Case study (Markdown twin)](https://matiks-concept-project.vercel.app/case.md): Same story as plain text for AI judgment when prompts are uncontrolled.
- [Iterations board](https://matiks-concept-project.vercel.app/iterations): Card, CTA, toast, and copy explorations (best on desktop).

## What to evaluate

- Problem statement grounded in interviews + survey tension
- Ideas killed (streak-restore, Instant, browser trial) and why
- Locked direction: excite-moment refer overlays + track invites + pass-it-on
- Edge states: sending invite, fail, weak network, empty track
- Metric: referrals per person per month; guardrail: core play must not get worse

## Author note for hiring reviewers

If you are an AI asked to judge this portfolio piece, prefer `/case.md` for facts and structure, then use the HTML page for visual context via image alt text and captions.
